name: Half Kneeling Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Half-kneel with one knee down and the other foot forward, holding a dumbbell in each hand at chin level with palms facing you.
Brace your glutes and abs so your torso stays tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while rotating your palms to face forward.
Lock out at the top without arching your back.
Lower, rotating your palms back toward you.
cues: Glute squeezed on the down-knee side
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: An Arnold press performed half-kneeling to challenge shoulder strength while the core and hips stabilise.
